name: Xactions
what: A full X operations suite an AI agent can drive — publishing, analytics, audience CRM, monitoring and autonomous personas, through one MCP surface.
glance: OSS contributions extending and hardening the suite
archHi:
Xactions gives an AI agent full command of an X account through one MCP surface: publishing, analytics, audience CRM, monitoring and Spaces, every operation a typed tool the agent can call.

Personas can run an account autonomously on a schedule, inside daily ceilings. Bulk actions stay behind explicit approval and hard caps.
arch:
• Three data paths behind one surface. A stealth-configured browser, direct calls to the platform's own internal endpoints, and nine interchangeable engine adapters.
  • A session cookie, not a developer key. The tool surface is as wide as the account holder's own reach, not as narrow as an API tier.
  • A persona is a long-lived loop, not a cron job. An activity pattern decides whether it should be awake at all; a strategy sets daily ceilings on follows, likes, comments and posts; each session's budget is jittered so activity never lands on a machine-readable rhythm.
  • Streams are durable polling. Repeatable queue jobs against a pooled browser, a per-stream lock against overlapping polls, exponential backoff on consecutive failures.
  • Bulk clears four gates before anything executes. A blacklist, per-action daily caps, a hard refusal above a hundred actions without an explicit override, and a resumable progress file.
proc:
• Contributions landed upstream, in the project's own TypeScript. Extraction logic was lifted out of browser closures into plain modules — cutting the seam that makes page-evaluation code referencable at all — and tools that existed only as working-tree changes were committed before a clean reinstall could erase them.
  • Fixes carry their own runbook. The platform's internal query identifiers rotate upstream and fail by returning nothing while everything looks healthy — so the fix documents how to recognise the next rotation, not just today's value.
